trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done. There is no shortcut — no online or DLC trophy, no difficulty setting, and one playthrough is enough. Expect around 200 hours, most of it on the 100% checklist behind A Long Road.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story and work the list. Everything you did before the credits already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable. You need every robbery, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, every underwater discovery, all Shooting Range golds, all drone races and Bret’s 15 Target Decks in full — plus a share of the rest: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops for finishing Gone Fishing, one of the first missions of Chapter 1. It cannot be missed — just play the story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. It usually pops once you have played the first mission of Chapter 2, What’s in the Bag?, rather than on the final Chapter 1 cutscene. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. It is awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after Welcome to Vice City. Unmissable.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. It arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. It pops as the story moves into Chapter 5. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the final mission. Free roam carries on after the credits, so everything else on this list can wait until after it pops. Unmissable.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. Play the mission and it pops. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy for Child’s Play in Chapter 4. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy for Headliners in Chapter 4. Unmissable.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy for VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy for Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, in any mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the fastest way to rack them up, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. Check your count under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and turn on Stunt Spots on the map. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race) and a stunt. Progress > Activities shows what is still missing.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 golds in total. The ranges also raise your Focus level, which makes Gunslinger easier, so work on this early.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations; one win per location is enough. The 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so it is worth clearing each location fully while you are there.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 available. Winning the same race again does not count, so keep moving to new events.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Work through his fishing quests and then beat him in his challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one arcade game. Three of them — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — are on the TV at home; the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger mission strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. The rest of the qualifying strands were still being confirmed at launch, so check the trophy’s progress counter after each strand you finish. None of them are needed for 100%, and they all stay available after the story. Do Yago’s Chapter 3 race, Race Against Yago, the moment it appears — it is time-sensitive (hourglass icon), so save first.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every Meditation Spot until the counter reaches 18. Meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, and the last one needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THIS IS THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation — it is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not confirmed whether the trophy needs it. Do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets — you do not need all of them. The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is.
trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1/RB). Any 100 count, drawn from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; Progress > Challenges marks finished ones. Many complete themselves while you play, and the 100% checklist needs 70.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once both characters are together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle/Y), build a 4-star Wanted Level and escape. It only counts once you are out of the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well, and bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you are still wanted (flashing red and blue). The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City — open after Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 — sit close together. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app; you do not need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so this comes along the way.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). Fill Focus first — eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer — and use an assault rifle. Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 gives you the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewelry store’s locked back door — kicking it in sets off the alarm — then find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Bank vaults open with the optional Chapter 4 mission That’s Where The Money Is…. Follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. 5 of the 8 vaults are enough here; 100% needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault counts, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or reach a Pay ’n’ Spray. Before vaults open, you can box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida. The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icons) from each of the 9 gangs; Progress > Gangs keeps count. The 100% checklist needs all 39.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Credit Check (Meet Raul’s Crew) in Chapter 3 gets you the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It is a running total of $250,000, and the robberies for 100% get you there.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: A running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app, available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2 — about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses’ Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay ’n’ Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space, so buy garages first, and each registration costs money — use cheap cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only. It starts in Chapter 3 when Andy texts her an address in Belville. Do all five missions in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass. The last one awards the trophy, and the strand is still there after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton (green KR icon in Key Lento) hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig it up. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so it can be finished then. Track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton’s Treasures.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy’s five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The fifth, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy, and the jobs stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy’s Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner (Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS). Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best places to look. Cars in better condition pay more.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. Once enough are gone, his last job, Shut Down the Labs, awards the trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret’s hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers the trophy was not confirmed at launch; the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, steal a big passenger jet docked at a departure gate’s boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge. The trophy is delayed — fly about 1 km out and it pops. Save first; police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County (tanks sit at the south end of the base) and take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED. The description is the only hint so far: have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City. No confirmed steps exist yet — do not trust any walkthrough that claims exact steps. This guide will be updated once a method is confirmed.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED. The description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom, in classic style. No confirmed steps exist yet — this guide will be updated once a method is confirmed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Take its three valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table, and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (Jason & Lucia > Strength in the pause menu). Work out at fitness clubs (Map > Activities) with your partner along: training one trains the other too. After the story you can also train at home.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players get it without trying; turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI to watch the count. Do not push towards the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED. “Second time’s the charm” suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, but no confirmed steps exist yet — this guide will be updated once a method is confirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED. Expect a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida, but no confirmed steps exist yet — this guide will be updated once a method is confirmed.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl ’em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED. The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle — a melee drive-by. No confirmed steps exist yet — this guide will be updated once a method is confirmed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
